defaultPrompt: Help me set up PentAGI from its official repository safely.
Help me plan an authorized security test with clear scope and evidence requirements.
Troubleshoot my PentAGI configuration without exposing secrets.
interface.longDescription: Helps you work with the vxcontrol/pentagi project: understand its architecture, plan a local setup, troubleshoot configuration, design authorized penetration tests, and prepare evidence-based reports. It provides guided advice and checklists; it does not connect to or execute PentAGI itself.

name: pentagi-security-workflow
description: Guided workflows for understanding, configuring, reviewing, and safely using the PentAGI autonomous penetration-testing platform.
